answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with stake-bonded reputation: each agent must lock a refundable bond before transacting, and the bond is slashed on proven fraud. A raven watcher flags suspicious clusters, while a falcon verifier re-checks flagged agents before any bond is released. The bridge between identity and value is the bond itself: spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so the attack costs real capital up front and failure burns it — cheap talk becomes expensive fraud.
